canonical_content_text:
Commercial crude oil inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) decreased 8.6 million barrels to 415.6 million barrels, 3% below the five-year average. Gasoline inventories increased 3.5 million barrels, 4% below the five-year average. Distillate inventories decreased 2.5 million barrels, 12% below the five-year average.

Crude oil imports decreased 791,000 b/d to 6.0 million b/d, although the four-week average of 6.1 million b/d is 0.9% above the year-ago level. Gasoline imports averaged 508,000 b/d; distillate imports averaged 145,000 b/d.

Working gas in storage was 3,567 Bcf as of Friday, October 9, 2026, according to EIA estimates. This represents a net increase of 67 Bcf from the previous week. Stocks were 143 Bcf less than last year at this time and 45 Bcf above the five-year average of 3,522 Bcf. At 3,567 Bcf, total working gas is within the five-year historical range.
